interpretation.observed: Triggering tick and its completed commit are retained. The long interval lies inside the writer execution span; transport, queue and reply spans are short for this operation.
limits: One consumeBridge request is incomplete at freeze; whole-process trace is not complete from start despite no dropped rows.
Incomplete bridge was sent during the already executing long commit; it cannot be assigned a completed execution duration from this trace.
Writer execution includes the commit callback and guard; the trace does not split SQL body, transaction finalization or fsync per operation.
Checkpoint maximum is cumulative and lacks per-call start/end correlation.
The separate storage job runs on another hosted runner; its mount/device measurements are not attributed to the browser job.
The observer adds bounded instrumentation overhead; this is no production capacity acceptance.
